**Supplier Obligations:**
* Appoint one account manager to coordinate contact with the client (L141, L151, L181).
* Perform a monthly maintenance visit at the logistics center in Holon and submit a visit report (L142, L152, L162, L170).
* Maintain an available inventory of spare parts for the factory service in Kiryat Gat (L144, L154, L164, L174).
* Supplier's technician shall arrive at the warehouse in Ashdod within 4 hours for an urgent call, and within 2 days for a regular call (L146, L156, L176).
* Insure its employees with employers' liability insurance and third-party liability insurance (L147, L157, L167).
* Both parties shall keep secret any information received as part of the engagement (L148, L158, L168, L178).
* Coordinate in advance with the site manager any work at the Kiryat Gat factory that requires a shutdown (L149, L159, L169, L177, L179).
* Any change in the scope of service shall be made in writing and signed by both parties (L163, L173, L175 - Note: attributed generally to changes, but applies to mutual/supplier actions).

**Client Obligations:**
* Pay the consideration within 45 days from the date of receiving a lawful tax invoice (L143, L153, L161, L171, L183).

**Fines (Supplier to Client):**
* Failure to meet repair times specified in the service appendix at the Holon logistics center: 20,750 NIS per case (L140).
* Cooling system shutdown exceeding four hours in the Tel Aviv offices: 22,500 NIS per case (L145).
* Leakage of client customer information under supplier responsibility: 48,000 NIS, in addition to any other remedy (L150).
* Replacing a technician without prior notice at the Haifa branch: 2,000 NIS per case (L155).
* Use of non-original spare parts in the Ashdod warehouse: 3,750 NIS per case (L161).
* Breach of on-site safety instructions at the Holon logistics center: 5,500 NIS per case (L166).
* Loss of client equipment in the Tel Aviv offices: 7,250 NIS per case (L171).
* Failure to perform preventive maintenance on time at the Kiryat Gat factory: 9,000 NIS per case (L177).
* Working without a valid entry permit at the Haifa branch: 10,750 NIS per case (L182).
